name: Composio
description: Expose an allowlisted set of Composio tools to the agent behind per-call approval.

apiKey.description: Composio API key. Falls back to the COMPOSIO_API_KEY environment variable.

userId.description: Composio user id used to resolve the connected account for tool execution.

allowedToolkits.description: Allowlist of Composio toolkit slugs (lowercase), for example github or gmail. Execution of tools outside this list is refused.

searchLimit.description: Maximum number of tools returned by composio_search.

requireApproval.description: Require per-call user approval before composio_execute runs. Defaults to true.
